papers.title: Enhancing resilience, flexibility, and well-being through cognitive-emotional training: behavioral and neural evidence
papers.reason: The title suggests human cognitive-emotional training, but no methodology is provided to establish an interactive task, eye tracking, qualifying EEG analysis, or computational cognitive model.

papers.title: Biomarker-based assessment of cerebral small vessel disease progression after ischemic stroke – a prospective cohort study (MA-BIO)
papers.reason: The title describes clinical biomarkers of small-vessel disease progression, with no evidence of executive-function tasks, eye tracking, qualifying EEG analysis, or cognitive process modelling.

papers.title: Clinical Characteristics and Influencing Factors of Cognitive Impairment in Patients With End-Stage Renal Disease Undergoing Maintenance Haemodialysis
papers.reason: The study assesses cognitive impairment using MoCA and clinical regression in haemodialysis patients but includes none of the specified behavioural, eye-tracking, EEG, or computational modelling methods.

papers.title: Effects of Comprehensive Bundled Nursing Care on Psychological Disorders in Mechanically Ventilated Intensive Care Unit Patients
papers.reason: Cognition is measured only as a MoCA outcome of a nursing intervention, without an interactive task, eye tracking, qualifying EEG analysis, or cognitive process model.

papers.title: The Potential Role of Amyloid Precursor Protein Fragments as a Screening Tool for Mild Cognitive Impairment
papers.reason: The paper evaluates a urinary biomarker and MoCA for MCI screening but does not use behavioural decision tasks, eye tracking, EEG, or generative cognitive modelling.

papers.title: Study on the Mechanism of Music Therapy in Improving Sleep Quality of Patients with Chronic Insomnia Based on EEG Signal Analysis
papers.reason: The study passively records sleep EEG and reports brain-wave morphology and sleep structure without a cognitive task or explicit frequency-domain or connectivity methodology meeting Element C.

papers.title: Research on the Recognition of Mild Cognitive Impairment Based on Deep Learning
papers.reason: The paper targets MCI classification from human medical data and mentions EEG preprocessing, but provides no frequency-domain or connectivity analysis and uses classifiers rather than a cognitive process model.

papers.title: Effects of Rhodiola rosea Combined With Auricular Vagus Nerve Electrical Stimulation on Gut Microbiota and Cognitive Function in Patients With Cognitive Impairment of Qi Deficiency and Blood Stasis Type
papers.reason: The clinical intervention measures cognition through MoCA and MMSE alongside microbiota and oxidative markers, with none of the four specified methodological elements.
